description: I do not care about everything. I do not have the capacity. #selflove #criticalthinking #maturity
transcript: I am neutral when it comes to most things. I don't have an opinion on everything. I do not have a response for most things. I don't have an answer for things that I do not understand. I do not enter twine in spaces where I don't mix. I do not have to exist everywhere. There are spaces that are built specifically for me are the spaces that I occupy. I don't care about everything. I am neutral.
